Simply put, thanks to their work Humanity now has a new item in its toolbox, which we can choose to use for good purposes. Machine learning based on ANNs is [...] and more. Decision support within health care is also a well-established application for ANNs. For example, a recent prospective randomized study of mammographic screening images showed a clear benefit of using machine learning in improving detection of breast cancer . Another recent example is motion correction for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans . Concluding remarks The pioneering methods and concepts developed by Hopfield and Hinton have been instrumental in shaping the field of ANNs.
